title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Administrator - Lisburn Road
- Location: Lisburn Road
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Salary: Competitive

Reed Recruitment is delighted to be working with a well-known, very successful and prestigious organisation, with offices based on the Lisburn Road.

Our client has an exciting new opportunity for an experienced Accounts Administrator to join their team on a full-time, permanent basis. This role is offering the opportunity to work within an established and supportive team, and the opportunity for career progression.

The successful applicant will be responsible for completing the following duties:
- Accounts Payable:
- Process a high volume of supplier invoices
- Verify invoices and ensure correct coding is applied
- Prepare and process supplier payment runs.
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolve discrepancies.
- Maintain accurate supplier records within the CRM and finance systems.
- Accounts Receivable:
- Generate and issue client statements
- Post and allocate incoming payments including bank transfers, card payments, and other payment methods.
- Monitor tenant debtor reports and assist with credit control activities.
- Financial Administration:
- Assist with bank reconciliations and maintenance of financial records.
- Support month-end procedures including reconciliations and reporting of outstanding balances

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Previous experience in accounts assistant, accounts payable, accounts receivable, or finance administration roles.
- Experience processing high volumes of invoices and financial transactions.
- Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy.
- Good organisational and time management skills.
- Proficiency with accounting software and financial systems.
- Strong communication skills when dealing with clients, suppliers, and internal teams.

Desirable:
- AAT qualification or currently studying towards AAT.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary and benefits
- Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
- Dynamic and supportive work environment.

If you would like to be considered for this position, then please apply via the link provided. Alternatively, please feel free to contact Caron Hamill from the Reed Offices directly and in the strictest of confidence. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper- Carryduff- Maternity Contract

Reed Recruitment are delighted to be working with a thriving and successful organisation with offices based in Carryduff. Our client has a new vacancy for an experienced Office Manager/ Assistant Accountant to join their team to cover a period of maternity.

This is a full-time role for a period of 9 months, and the successful applicant will be required to complete the following duties:
- Processing weekly payroll, including maintaining holiday entitlement records for all employees ( circa 40 employees)
- Purchase ledger invoice processing
- Liaising with suppliers and managing queries
- Payment runs
- Managing debt collection and ensuring customer accounts remain up to date
- Processing online banking transactions and recording payments and receipts on Sage
- Assisting with online bookings and purchases as required
- Providing general administrative support across the business

Essential Criteria
- Previous experience in a payroll, accounts or finance administration role
- Experience in Sage Accounts
- A minimum of three years' experience completing the above job duties
- Available to start at short notice

Benefits
- Competitive salary of up to £34,000 dependent on experience
- Full-time hours, Monday- Friday 9am-5pm
- In office role with parking
- Working within a supportive and friendly team environment

If you would like to be considered for this position, then please apply via the link provided. Alternatively, please feel free to contact Caron Hamill from the Reed Offices directly and in the strictest of confidence. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Urgent- Accounts Assistant- Lisburn

Reed Recruitment is working in partnership with a local Lisburn Company, who require an experienced Accounts Administrator on a temporary basis. This is a full-time role, offering the successful applicant an immediate start, and will be for a period of 6 months, with possible extension.

As the company is growing, an opportunity for a permanent position may become available within the 6 months dependent on company needs and the successful applicant's performance within the role.

Daily Duties will include the following:
- Sales invoicing for installations, servicing, repairs and maintenance contracts
- Purchase ledger and supplier reconciliations
- Credit control, customer statements and receipt allocation
- Bank and ledger reconciliations
- Employee expenses and support with month-end
- General accounting administrative duties

Candidate Requirements
- At least three years relevant experience covering invoicing, purchases, credit control and VAT
- Strong bookkeeping, Excel and accounting software skills, with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines

Benefits:
- Immediate start

- Weekly pay
- Full-time hours ( Monday- Friday 9am-5pm, Friday 9am-4pm)
- 6-month contract with possible extension
- Free parking
- Lisburn offices
